item.title: Alphabet's DeepMind shake-up caps months of AI stumbles
item.summary: Alphabet's decision to shift day-to-day control of Google DeepMind from Demis Hassabis to his deputy, Koray Kavukcuoglu, was not sudden—it capped a difficult year in which Google lost ground to rivals in the AI race, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
